🔥 reel-generator | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate beat-synced video reels from raw video clips and a song, simplifying the video editing process for social media.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic beat-synced reel generation • Intelligent moment selection from long videos • Handles various phone media formats (HEIC, HDR) • Multiple editing styles (Hype, Smooth, Cinematic) • Audio sourcing from YouTube links or uploads
📖 Summary: Reel Maker is a Python-based tool that automatically creates Instagram Reels by analyzing video clips and music to sync cuts to the beat. It processes raw phone media, identifies key moments, and applies different editing styles without manual trimming or AI.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 seeker | CSS
🎯 Primary Use Case: To demonstrate and educate users about the potential data a malicious website can gather by tricking them into granting location and other permissions, serving as a proof-of-concept for social engineering tactics.
✨ Key Features: • Hosts a fake website to request location permission • Collects longitude, latitude, accuracy, and altitude
📖 Summary: Seeker is a tool that leverages social engineering by hosting a fake website to trick users into granting location permissions. Upon granting permission, it collects precise location data (longitude, latitude, accuracy, altitude) and various device information (unique ID, model, OS, hardware specs, IP addresses) without requiring explicit device permissions.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 roxum-ide | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a fully-featured Integrated Development Environment (IDE) on Android devices, enabling mobile coding, debugging, and development workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Flutter-based mobile IDE for Android • Built-in Termux support • Offline GGUF LLM model support for chat and code completion • Offline compilers and extensions for popular languages • 245 built-in themes and custom theme creation
📖 Summary: Roxum IDE is a Flutter-based mobile IDE for Android, offering a comprehensive suite of tools for code editing, terminal workflows, and AI assistance. It aims to provide a powerful and customizable development environment directly on mobile devices.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 note-gen | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a seamless workflow for capturing fleeting ideas and scattered information, and then intelligently organizing them into coherent Markdown notes using AI, thereby enhancing personal knowledge management.
✨ Key Features: • Local-first Markdown application
📖 Summary: NoteGen is a local-first Markdown application designed to streamline the process of capturing and organizing information. It allows users to quickly save various types of content, such as text, voice recordings, screenshots, and links, without immediate organization. Later, users can select related captured items and use AI to organize them into structured Markdown notes, facilitating efficient knowledge management.
